nodes.description: Private owner address of Ownable; represents contract ownership privilege.
Payable developer address #1 that receives a share of incoming ETH.
Payable developer address #2 that receives a share of incoming ETH.
uint8 divisor applied to msg.value for dev1; owner-settable and may be zero.
uint8 divisor applied to msg.value for dev2; owner-settable and may be zero.
Internal view helper returning msg.sender, used for ownership checks and initialization.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a non-zero new owner.
Private helper writing the new owner into _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Payable fallback that splits msg.value between dev1 and dev2 using divamount1/divamount2.
onlyOwner function updating divamount1 and divamount2 (can be set to 0, causing revert on division).
onlyOwner function updating the developer payout addresses dev1 and dev2.
Caller-controlled address read in _msgSender; used for owner initialization and onlyOwner checks.
dev1.transfer(amount / divamount1): external ETH transfer to a payable address with value derived from msg.value and a state divisor.
dev2.transfer(amount / divamount2): external ETH transfer to a payable address with value derived from msg.value and a state divisor.
New divisor value for divamount1 supplied to changeDivideAmount.
New divisor value for divamount2 supplied to changeDivideAmount.
New payable address assigned to dev1 by changeDevAddresses.
New payable address assigned to dev2 by changeDevAddresses.
Address passed to transferOwnership and validated as non-zero.
Local variable in receive() holding msg.value, the ETH to be split between dev1 and dev2.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by the _msgSender helper.
In the constructor msg.sender (via _msgSender) is written into _owner, so the deployer caller determines contract ownership.
_msgSender return value is used to initialize _owner and to authorize onlyOwner checks.
newOwner parameter flows through transferOwnership into _setOwner, updating the privileged _owner.
transferOwnership onlyOwner invokes the private _setOwner to change ownership.
transferOwnership ultimately writes _owner through _setOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against _msgSender() (msg.sender) to authorize callers.
newamount1 is written directly into the divamount1 state divisor.
newamount2 is written directly into the divamount2 state divisor.
changeDivideAmount is onlyOwner-gated and rewrites divamount1, controlling payout math.
changeDivideAmount is onlyOwner-gated and rewrites divamount2, controlling payout math.
newdev1 is written into the dev1 payout address.
newdev2 is written into the dev2 payout address.
changeDevAddresses is onlyOwner-gated and updates the dev1 payout destination.
changeDevAddresses is onlyOwner-gated and updates the dev2 payout destination.
Constructor parameter _dev1 initializes the dev1 payout address; the constructor itself holds ownership privileges.
Constructor parameter _dev2 initializes the dev2 payout address; the constructor itself holds ownership privileges.
receive() executes after the constructor-established payout configuration is in place.
receive() triggers the external dev1.transfer call while executing payable entry logic.
receive() triggers the external dev2.transfer call while executing payable entry logic.
The dev1 state address is the destination of the external ETH transfer, so an owner/attacker-controlled address receives the call.
The dev2 state address is the destination of the external ETH transfer, so an owner/attacker-controlled address receives the call.
divamount1 divides the transferred amount; if set to 0 the division reverts (arithmetic failure) and it controls the ETH amount sent.
divamount2 divides the transferred amount; if set to 0 the division reverts (arithmetic failure) and it controls the ETH amount sent.
Constructor-set dev1 determines the recipient of the first ETH transfer.
Constructor-set addresses feed the split of msg.value across both transfers.
An external transfer to a payable recipient can re-enter the contract's receive() fallback before the payout logic completes.
The second external transfer to a payable recipient can also re-enter the receive() fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: The local amount (msg.value) exists only to compute the value of the external ETH transfers to dev1/dev2.
